% Fixture for #310 S0 — an anonymous, ungraded survey sheet, the shape
% apps/server's survey generator (internal/domain/survey/tex) emits.
%
% What makes it a survey and not a control, each measured in the S0 spike:
%
%   * No \namefield and no \AMCcode: nothing on the sheet says who filled it.
%     AMC then reports every copy's RUT as `unreadable` and every copy as
%     `needs_review` — the survey reader ignores both and reads the answers.
%   * No \element / \shufflegroup, and every choices environment is `[o]`:
%     questions and alternatives print in authored order, so a scale reads
%     1..N left to right.
%   * Every SIMPLE question carries exactly ONE \correctchoice (the first).
%     A survey has no correct answer, but AMC refuses a simple question with
%     zero or with all correct ("0/3 good answers not coherent for a simple
%     question", measured both ways), and `/analyse` needs the scoring tables
%     `prepare --mode b` + `note` build. The score is computed and ignored;
%     the marks are what the survey keeps. A questionmult accepts all
%     \wrongchoice, so the multi-select needs no such stand-in.
%
% Content is Spanish because a student reads it (apps/amc-worker/CLAUDE.md
% §Language).
%
% Below the comments this file is EXACTLY what the generator emits for the
% same bank (TestTheGeneratorReproducesTheSheetTheWorkerReads), so the sheet
% this script reads is the sheet production prints. Change one, change both.

\documentclass[letterpaper,11pt]{article}

\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[spanish]{babel}
\usepackage[box,lang=ES]{automultiplechoice}

\def\unaSymbole{\textsf{\small(una respuesta)}}
\def\multiSymbole{\textsf{\small(varias respuestas)}}

\AMCrandomseed{1}

\begin{document}

\onecopy{3}{

  \noindent{\large\bf Autoevaluación de conceptos}

  \smallskip
  \noindent Encuesta anónima: no escribas tu nombre.

  \smallskip
  \noindent\textbf{Rellena por completo el cuadrado de tu respuesta.}

  \subsection*{Contexto}

  \begin{question}[\unaSymbole]{q1}
    ¿En qué sección estás?
    \begin{choices}[o]
      \correctchoice{A}
      \wrongchoice{B}
      \wrongchoice{C}
    \end{choices}
  \end{question}

  \subsection*{Confianza en los temas}

  \begin{question}[\unaSymbole]{q2}
    ¿Qué tan clara te resultó la definición de TDA?
    \begin{choiceshoriz}[o]
      \correctchoice{1 Nada clara}
      \wrongchoice{2}
      \wrongchoice{3}
      \wrongchoice{4}
      \wrongchoice{5 Muy clara}
    \end{choiceshoriz}
  \end{question}

  \begin{questionmult}{q3}
    ¿Qué estructuras te costó más entender? (marca entre 1 y 3)
    \begin{choices}[o]
      \wrongchoice{ArrayList}
      \wrongchoice{Lista enlazada}
      \wrongchoice{Heap}
      \wrongchoice{BST}
    \end{choices}
  \end{questionmult}

  \begin{question}[\unaSymbole]{q4}
    El ritmo de las clases te pareció...
    \begin{choiceshoriz}[o]
      \correctchoice{1 lento}
      \wrongchoice{2 adecuado}
      \wrongchoice{3 rápido}
      \wrongchoice{4 muy rápido}
    \end{choiceshoriz}
  \end{question}

  \clearpage
}

\end{document}
